subject: Comment out assert in kvstore for overhead lut (#1745)
reason: The change only comments out a debug consistency assert in kvstoreRelease(); no code path, reply, data structure, or persistence/replication behaviour changes. The only state in which the two builds would differ is one where the overhead_hashtable_lut accounting is nonzero at release time, causing the parent to abort - a condition whose cause is unknown (per the TODO the maintainers added) and which cannot be deliberately reached from client commands; in every normal run both builds behave identically through FLUSHALL ASYNC, SWAPDB and shutdown, the callers of kvstoreRelease.
